title: Create RecipeCatalog core model and loader
description: Add the new observable `RecipeCatalog` and its entry/grouping model in `CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeCatalog.swift`. Implement recursive `.cook` enumeration, eager parsing, thumbnail lookup reuse, parse-failure logging through `Loggers.recipes`, off-main-thread load execution, and main-actor state publication while preserving previous results during reload.
acceptance_criteria: `RecipeCatalog` is an `@Observable` type with enough public surface to expose loaded state, loading state, grouped recipes, reload entry points, and access to parsed recipes already in memory.
Catalog loading walks the configured recipes folder recursively with the same effective recipe scope as the current discovery flow and parses every discovered `.cook` file.
Malformed recipes are omitted from catalog results and log an error through `Loggers.recipes` with public file path and private error text.
Reload does not clear existing results before replacement, and state updates occur on the main actor after background work completes.
